summary_en: Ferrotec completed a tender offer for Nihon Resistor Manufacturing (6977) at 1,901 yen per share, acquiring 1,083,273 shares (87.5% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock). The target becomes a consolidated subsidiary effective November 12, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Tender Offer for Nihon Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 6977) and Notice Regarding Changes in Subsidiaries
translation_en_brief:
Ferrotec Corporation, a Tokyo-listed company on the TSE Standard Market, completed a tender offer for Nihon Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (code 6977), which is also listed on the TSE Standard Market. The offer was initiated by Ferrotec's board of directors on September 17, 2026, and the tender offer period ran from September 18, 2026, to November 5, 2026 (30 business days).

The offer price was set at 1,901 yen per ordinary share. The tender offer included a minimum condition: if aggregate applications fell below 618,700 shares, Ferrotec would not complete any acquisition. However, 1,083,273 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum threshold. Ferrotec acquired all 1,083,273 tendered shares, representing 87.5% of Nihon Resistor Manufacturing's outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). Fractional shares were included in the tender offer scope.

As a result of the completed tender offer, Nihon Resistor Manufacturing is scheduled to become a consolidated subsidiary of Ferrotec effective November 12, 2026, which is the settlement start date. No treasury shares held by Nihon Resistor Manufacturing were acquired in this transaction.
